title: Zigzag
description: A poster grid of black zigzags, after the Whitney's responsive W. Five frames share their gutters, and each holds its own solved W at one stroke weight. Drag any gutter and the frames on both sides re-proportion at once: one W goes flat and panoramic while its neighbour goes tall and narrow, and every mitre still lands exactly on all four sides of its frame.
intent: Translate Experimental Jetset's 2013 responsive W for the Whitney: one rule, a line that touches every edge of its frame, makes a mark that fits any format. https://www.designboom.com/design/new-whitney-museum-identity-by-experimental-jetset/
